lessons_used: No kind of change has proven helpful yet, as no test resulted in a statistically significant win.
Sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) tends to have a negative impact, as 2 tests agree after noise correction (-2.2% overall).
Adding new finish screens (finish, new_screen) tends to have a negative impact, as 2 tests agree after noise correction (-2.3% overall).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) showed no clear effect across 2 tests, as neither test resulted in a statistically significant win.
Evidence is still thin for home flows (home, new_flow), path redesigns (choose_path, redesign), and adoption flows (adoption, new_flow), as each has only 1 test.
Predictions were consistently too high and overly optimistic across tests.

candidates.title: Desktop Waiting Activity Flow
candidates.change: Introduces a companion tip carousel flow during the waiting phase so users can learn desktop pet interactions while waiting.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, and support emails show confusion about how to control pets after onboarding.

new_waiting_tips.headline: While Your Companion Prepares
new_waiting_tips.body: Explore basic controls and desktop interaction tips while pet creation finishes in the background.

components.text: Drag pet to move, right-click to hide or adjust settings.

guard.reason: Adds a new waiting tips screen within onboarding while retaining all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high duration and support confusion, but requires new flow implementation.

candidates.title: Path Selection Centered Layout
candidates.change: Redesigns the path choice screen into a clean centered layout with structured path selection cards.
candidates.why: The choose_path step takes a mean time of 514s despite an 8s median, indicating substantial hesitation for some users.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Desktop Companion Journey
choose_path.body: Choose whether to adopt a pre-made pet companion or craft a custom pet from your own photos.

guard.reason: Redesigns choose path screen while preserving choices for adopting and creating custom pets.

candidates.score_note: Targets high mean time on path selection, backed mainly by funnel metrics.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Compact Layout
candidates.change: Rebuilds the photo upload view into a compact layout with direct image previews.
candidates.why: The adoption step has the lowest step conversion in the core funnel (60.9%) and long mean completion times (1017s).

upload_photos.headline: Add Pet Photos for Custom Mascot
upload_photos.body: Upload 1 to 3 photos of your pet to generate their desktop companion avatar.

guard.reason: Redesigns photo upload layout while keeping its required function intact.

candidates.score_note: Targets lowest step conversion (60.9%), but adoption redesigns show modest historic lift.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Preview Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a confirmation preview screen right after photo upload to confirm visual style before starting generation.
candidates.why: Support receives emails regarding custom pet creation failing or looking wrong after onboarding.

new_pet_preview.headline: Preview Companion Style
new_pet_preview.body: Review your photo selection and avatar preview before finalizing adoption.

guard.reason: Inserts custom pet preview screen inside onboarding without removing required steps.

candidates.score_note: Supported by emails and funnel drop, but adding new screens previously reduced conversion.

candidates.title: Sign-In Sync Explanation Hint
candidates.change: Adds a hint explaining that signing in connects past adopted pets to this account to prevent account reset confusion.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in ensures your desktop companions remain saved to your account across reinstalls.

guard.reason: Adds sign-in explanation hint without modifying pricing or dark patterns.

candidates.score_note: Simple hint addressing sign-in reset confusion with low implementation cost.

candidates.title: Background Generation Time Indicator
candidates.change: Displays estimated remaining time and background processing advice on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Users spend a median of 201s waiting, causing drop-off or app exit before pet creation completes.

waiting.hint: Generation takes ~2-3 minutes. You can safely minimize this window.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Interaction Summary Copy
candidates.change: Updates the home intro screen copy to clearly explain how to reveal, hide, and interact with the pet on desktop.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Click and drag your pet anywhere on screen. Right-click your pet to open controls, settings, or hide it.

guard.reason: Updates home intro screen text with helpful interaction instructions.

candidates.score_note: Solves prominent support confusion on the final step via quick copy configuration.

candidates.title: Starter Pet Accessory Unlock Incentive
candidates.change: Adds a bonus badge highlighting that completing path setup unlocks starter pet items.
candidates.why: Path selection drop-off reduces conversion down to 76.2%.

guard.reason: Mentions accessory bundle extras in onboarding copy, violating Rule 3 prohibition on gifts and extras.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Lighting Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Adds visual photo quality guidelines on the upload screen to ensure pet photo generation succeeds.
candidates.why: Support receives bug reports regarding custom pet generation failures and rendering issues.

upload_photos.hint: Clear, well-lit photos with face visible produce the best desktop pet renders.

guard.reason: Adds helpful photo quality guidance hint to photo upload screen.

candidates.score_note: Directly addresses photo failure support reports at the lowest-converting step.

candidates.title: Home Intro Centered Welcome Card
candidates.change: Changes the home intro layout to a clean centered view with clear action buttons.
candidates.why: Only 64.8% of users finish the home intro stage, losing users right at the final step.

guard.reason: Redesigns home intro layout without removing functionality.

candidates.score_note: Targets 35.2% drop-off at final step, but evidence relies solely on funnel data.
